title: HIIT Timer
description: A configurable high-intensity interval timer: set work/rest seconds and rounds, with audio cues on every switch.
howto: Set your work seconds, rest seconds and number of rounds.
Press Start and follow the phase display.
A beep marks every work/rest switch; pause or reset anytime.

faqs.q: What is a good starter HIIT setup?
faqs.a: 20 seconds work / 10 seconds rest × 8 rounds (classic Tabata) or 30/30 × 6. Warm up 5 minutes first.

faqs.q: Why do I not hear the beep?
faqs.a: Your device must not be muted and the page needs to stay open. The beep uses your browser audio.
Yes — Pause freezes the countdown exactly where it is; Resume continues the same round.
